text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAARRGHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! Maya took 1st place! First 
place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maya worked hard! But I can still do 
way more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, because, you see—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Mayano, that's super-duper 
amazing! Next up is the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAARRGHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone must be thinking that Maya can 
shine even brighter♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Yes! Beat my best time 
again!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: With this, the Arima Kinen will also――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Brian. Is that story true?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the Arima Kinen, you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
President, what's the point of talking 
about the future?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"What I asked you to do just now was run 
alongside me. Am I wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That... is true, but.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I am the one who decides when my petals 
fall.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it's a discussion you desire, then 
stand over there and watch with your thumb 
in your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, I will simply be the one 
who runs off with the win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: H-Hey!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fiercely independent, walking solely on 
one's own path. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't go thinking everyone will just be 
left behind!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Sparkling once again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The more I look at it, the more 
frustrating it is. How can they still 
shine so brightly?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even though she is already—about to sink 
into the depths.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The evening sun shines far redder and 
brighter than it does in the morning or 
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before it falls, before it sinks. With 
just a fleeting sparkle, the setting sun 
captures the hearts of people.
choice_data_list: Don't let that brilliance outshine you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I lose to that light, I feel like I'll 
never be able to win for the rest of my 
life.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm going all out. In the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With everything I've got... I will beat 
her!!
